sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption evaluated emergency grants administered by the treasury and primary industries departments.
sentences.support: examines four programs administered by two departments, which delivered relief and recovery payments and other measures

sentences.text: It examined four programs responding to the pandemic, bushfires and floods, reviewing program controls rather than individual grant decisions.
sentences.support: practices, policies, and procedures have been evaluated at the program level, rather than at the level of administration of individual grants.

sentences.text: The Commission found that both departments addressed the main corruption risks appropriately, while identifying improvements.
sentences.support: While several areas are identified for improvement, the agencies appropriately addressed key corruption risks in their administration of the programs.

sentences.text: Its nine recommendations covered staffing for emergencies, data handling, public information, conflict declarations, preparation and access to Commonwealth information.
sentences.support: Identifying and establishing data sharing arrangements in South Australian government agencies where emergency grants programs support similar activities.

findings.quote: While several areas are identified for improvement, the agencies appropriately addressed key corruption risks in their administration of the programs.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. The evaluation addresses program-level controls, not individual grants.
